clue.text: Desert plant unfortunately accidentally recorded initially within 'dessert'

indicators.note: within says the first letters sit inside the pudding's name

parts.note: sago is a milk pudding, a classic school dessert

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of each of the three words before it

explanation.surface: Someone mortified that a typo turned 'desert' into 'dessert' in their write-up on a cactus.
explanation.walkthrough: The quoted 'dessert' looks like a joke about spelling; it is just the pudding SAGO, with UAR put inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The saguaro is the giant columnar cactus of the Sonoran Desert, a plant of arid lands.

clue.text: Console expert after smear sees one sacked

indicators.note: after places the word for expert behind the word for smear
sacked means dismissed, so the one is thrown out of the letters

parts.note: to smear something is to soil it
one is the Roman numeral I
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: A games console specialist, after a smear campaign, watches a colleague get fired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Console' looks like the games machine but is the verb to comfort.
explanation.definitionFit: To console someone is to comfort them, which is what giving solace means.

clue.text: Finished with notes about one investing in goods as a rule?

indicators.note: investing in means wrapping, so the letters are placed inside the pair for goods

parts.note: G is short for good, so two of them stand for goods
finished means over

indicators.note: about means the pair of letters for notes go around the one

parts.note: N is an abbreviation for note, so two of them stand for notes
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone finishes with banknotes about a single investment in goods, as is their habit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as a rule?' plays on rule meaning to govern: acting as a rule does is governing.
explanation.definitionFit: A rule governs conduct, so something acting as a rule is in control, ruling or directing.

clue.text: A lot of post about violinist's latest violin

indicators.note: about puts those letters around the letter that follows
a lot of means most of, so the word for post loses its last letter

parts.note: post is mail

indicators.note: latest asks for the final letter of the word for the violin player

explanation.surface: A violinist's newest instrument arrives in a big batch of post.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A lot of' reads as one phrase, but A stands alone and 'lot of' trims MAIL to MAI.
explanation.definitionFit: Amatis are violins made by the Amati family of Cremona, so one names a fine violin.

clue.text: Encouraging a tip that's not on the scale

parts.note: something not on is off
a balance is a weighing scale

explanation.surface: A tip so encouraging it does not even register on the scale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Encouraging a tip' looks like praising a gratuity; it means making something likely to tip over.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unsteady means you are liable to topple, so an unstable stance invites a tip.

clue.text: Failure, not quite incurring negative returns, is to look good suddenly

indicators.note: incurring means taking on, so the shortened failure holds the next piece
not quite means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a flop is a bomb
negative returns on an investment are a loss

explanation.surface: A failed venture, nearly incurring losses, suddenly starts to look good.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is to' is link; the definition is a verb phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: To blossom is to flower or flourish, coming suddenly into beauty or good health.

clue.text: Poet using only 25 letters?

parts.note: a writer with one of the 26 letters of the alphabet banned has had it barred, which sounds like the word for a poet

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the pun: one letter being barred sounds like the poet.
explanation.definitionFit: A bard is a poet, especially one in the old Celtic tradition, or Shakespeare.

clue.text: High point in treatment of arioso seen in choral works

indicators.note: in puts the hilltop inside the reworked letters
treatment of means the letters of arioso are worked over into a new order

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hilltop, a high point

explanation.surface: A musical climax arrives in a performance of an arioso within some choral pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High point' sounds musical but is TOR, set inside AROIOS (the anagram of ARIOSO): ORA + TOR + IOS.
explanation.definitionFit: An oratorio is a large-scale sacred musical work for choir, soloists and orchestra.

clue.text: Military headgear to wobble endlessly round

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: to wobble is to shake
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A soldier's tall hat that wobbles endlessly round.
explanation.definitionFit: A shako is a tall cylindrical peaked cap worn by soldiers, often with a plume.

clue.text: Came running with sound upsetting rich man

indicators.note: running suggests the letters of came are set in motion and rearranged
in a down clue upsetting turns the word upside down, so it reads backwards

parts.note: sound as in sound of mind means sane

explanation.surface: Someone came running when an upsetting noise disturbed a wealthy man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'running' rearranges CAME to MAEC; 'upsetting' turns SANE into ENAS.
explanation.definitionFit: Maecenas was the wealthy Roman patron of Virgil and Horace, whose name now means a rich benefactor.

clue.text: Endlessly cross with a Roman matriarch

indicators.note: endlessly means the final letter is removed

parts.note: cross means furious, livid

explanation.surface: A Roman matriarch who is forever cross.
explanation.definitionFit: Livia, wife of Augustus and mother of Tiberius, was the dominant woman of the first imperial family.

clue.text: Fellow cross about energy shown by silver mineral

indicators.note: about means the angry word goes round the next letters

parts.note: cross means angry, irate
E is the physics symbol for energy
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A man gets angry about the energy a silver mineral displays.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shown by' is link.
explanation.definitionFit: Fire agate is a variety of chalcedony with iridescent flashes, a mineral used as a gemstone.

clue.text: Religious leader almost completely behind Queen, say

indicators.note: behind places the shortened phrase after the playing card

parts.note: a queen is an example of a playing card

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: in all means completely, altogether

explanation.surface: A religious leader stands almost entirely behind the Queen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Queen, say' looks royal; 'say' flags an example, a card in a pack.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardinals are senior Roman Catholic clergy who elect the Pope.

clue.text: Animal, shy, heading away from observation

parts.note: coy means bashful, shy

indicators.note: heading away from means its first letter goes

parts.note: a note is an observation or remark

explanation.surface: A shy animal slinking away from human observation.
explanation.definitionFit: The coyote is a wild North American member of the dog family.

clue.text: Comfortable place to exist for ailing tucking into medicines

parts.note: to be is to exist

indicators.note: tucking into means the rearranged letters go inside the medicines

parts.note: doses are measured amounts of medicine

indicators.note: ailing means unwell, so the letters of for are out of shape

explanation.surface: For someone ailing, medicines are the comfortable way to get through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ailing' rearranges FOR to OFR, which goes inside DOSES to give DOFROSES, after BE.
explanation.definitionFit: Life being no bed of roses is the idiom; the phrase means an easy, pleasant situation.

clue.text: Animated image with flowing water depicting suitable presents

parts.note: a GIF is an animated image file

indicators.note: flowing water suggests letters moving into a new order

explanation.surface: An animated picture of running water used to illustrate gift ideas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flowing' rearranges WATER to TWARE.
explanation.definitionFit: Giftware is goods sold as presents, items made for giving.

clue.text: Quite sour, out of sorts, somewhat blue?

indicators.note: out of sorts means disordered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone quite sour and out of sorts, feeling a bit blue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somewhat blue' plays on blue as sad; it is the colour, a greenish blue.
explanation.definitionFit: This colour is a greenish shade of blue, so only partly blue.

clue.text: Country to support province after reverse

indicators.note: after reverse means both pieces are read backwards together

parts.note: to aid is to support
NI is Northern Ireland, the UK's province

explanation.surface: A country pledges support to a province after a setback.
explanation.walkthrough: Northern Ireland is often called simply the Province in the UK.
explanation.definitionFit: India is a large country of South Asia.

clue.text: Very nice with run for leadership of Congress getting crazy

indicators.note: for means one letter stands in place of another

parts.note: delicious means very nice, delightful

indicators.note: leadership of asks for the first letter

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A US politician's run for leadership of Congress drives everyone crazy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'run for' reads as standing for office; here R replaces C in DELICIOUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Delirium is wild excitement or mental disturbance, so the adjective means frenzied, out of one's mind.

clue.text: Criticism appropriate for stonewalling cricketer

definitions.meaning: a harsh remark, a piece of censure
a batter who stonewalls blocks every ball as if wielding a bat made of brick

explanation.surface: Criticism fitting a batter who refuses to score.
explanation.walkthrough: Stonewalling in cricket is ultra-defensive batting, blocking every ball rather than scoring.
explanation.definitionFit: Brickbats are blunt criticisms, from the brick pieces once thrown at people.

clue.text: I heard that monarchs will suppress regressive personality

indicators.note: suppress means holding down within, so the monarchs enclose the next letters

parts.note: R stands for Rex or Regina, king or queen, so two are monarchs

indicators.note: regressive means going backwards, so the word is reversed

parts.note: ego is the sense of self, the personality

explanation.surface: Monarchs will crush any backward-looking personality, I gather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regressive' turns EGO into OGE, inside R and R.
explanation.definitionFit: In radio talk this word acknowledges a message: received and understood.

clue.text: Angry with work regarding some tyres

parts.note: cross means angry
to ply is to work at a trade

explanation.surface: Someone angry about the work involved in fitting some tyres.
explanation.definitionFit: A cross-ply tyre has cords running diagonally, describing a kind of tyre construction.

clue.text: Means to get on, heading for career in US city

parts.note: to get on is to grow old, to age

indicators.note: in places the initial letter inside the city's abbreviation

parts.note: NY is New York

indicators.note: heading for asks for the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A way to get on, starting a career in an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: Agency means instrumentality, as in by the agency of, the medium through which something is done.

clue.text: Desert plant around Connecticut (America)

parts.note: ca, short for circa, means around
CT is the postal abbreviation for Connecticut

explanation.surface: A desert plant growing around Connecticut, in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Cacti are succulents adapted to arid lands, the standard plant of the desert.

clue.text: Classic lover, very disengaged from church and romance

indicators.note: disengaged from means taken out of the word for romance

parts.note: love is romance

explanation.surface: A classic lover breaks off an engagement with church and romance.
explanation.definitionFit: She is the heroine of the Greek pastoral romance Daphnis and Chloe by Longus.

clue.text: Two-thirds of grotto collapsed around rock amphibian

indicators.note: around puts the jumbled letters on either side of the next piece
collapsed means fallen in, so those letters are jumbled
two-thirds of means the first four of its six letters

parts.note: a reef is a ridge of rock at sea

explanation.surface: A partly collapsed grotto around some rocks where an amphibian lives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'collapsed' rearranges GROT into TROG, which goes around REEF.
explanation.definitionFit: These are frogs adapted to climbing, living in trees; frogs are amphibians.

clue.text: Fish circling cross current's beginning to do well

indicators.note: circling means the fish goes around the other letters

parts.note: an eel is a fish
X is a cross

indicators.note: beginning asks for the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A fish circles a crossing current where it starts to thrive.
explanation.definitionFit: To excel is to be outstanding, to perform very successfully.

clue.text: Architect right to block big ugly city

indicators.note: to block means sit inside, so the letter goes into the city's name

parts.note: the Great Wen was Cobbett's name for London, a wen being a swelling

explanation.surface: An architect's right to block an ugly sprawling city development.
explanation.walkthrough: WEN for a big ugly city comes from William Cobbett calling London 'the Great Wen', a wen being a boil.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Christopher Wren was the architect of St Paul's Cathedral in London.

clue.text: Poor one engaged in one option for fives (a game)

indicators.note: engaged in means held within, so these letters go inside the next piece

parts.note: fives here means more than one answer to 5 down, whose answer is a poet; poets are one option
ill means poorly
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A poor player takes part in one of the options for a game of fives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fives' looks like the British handball game but refers to the 5-down answer in the plural, poets.
explanation.definitionFit: Billiards is a cue game played on a cloth-covered table with three balls.

clue.text: Comedian, one whose heart is given over to depression

definitions.text: one whose heart is given over to depression
definitions.meaning: the word's middle letters spell a word meaning a depression, so its heart is a dip

explanation.surface: A comedian whose heart is given over to depression.
explanation.walkthrough: The sad-clown picture misleads: the heart of the word itself is LOW, a depression.
explanation.definitionFit: A circus jester who clowns about is a comedian, someone who makes people laugh.

clue.text: Take this to fill can in that

indicators.note: to fill means placed inside the container

parts.note: a tin is a can
here, as said when handing something over, means take this

explanation.surface: An instruction to take something and stuff it into a can.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take this' sounds like an order; it is HERE, said when handing something over.
explanation.definitionFit: Therein is formal for in that place or in that respect.

clue.text: Informer receiving punishment of a watery sort

indicators.note: receiving means the informer holds the next piece

parts.note: a spy informs on others
the lash is punishment by whipping

explanation.surface: An informer gets punished by a dunking in water.
explanation.definitionFit: Splashy describes something making splashes, wet and watery.
